answer: Sybil tax: each new identity pays 30 credits before trading, burned not staked, so it is a sunk cost no one recovers. A cipher proof binds each receipt to one keypair, and the registry publishes it as a public signal that the identity paid. An honest agent pays 30 once and earns 120 credits per epoch at the zenith of its reputation. An attacker minting 100 fakes pays 3,000 up front and earns nothing, since no two copies can share one receipt.
